Channel.OWNS: Created when a user creates a channel they own. This represents ownership of the channel.
Channel.CAN_ACCESS: Created when a channel is shared with a user for collaborative access without ownership.
Channel.SUBSCRIBED_TO: Created when a global channel is linked into a user's tree as read-only access.
Channel.LINKS: Canonical relation for user-created link placements without ownership transfer.
Channel.LINKS_CHANNEL: Legacy channel link relation copied forward to LINKS.

Category.OWNS: Created when a user creates a category they own.
Category.CAN_ACCESS: Created when category access is granted without ownership.

SubjectRef.OWNS: Created when a user creates/attaches a subject they own.
SubjectRef.CAN_ACCESS: Created when subject access is granted without ownership.

PermissionProfile.USES_PERMISSION_PROFILE: Created when a user permission node references a reusable permission profile.

Channel.CONTAINS_CHANNEL: Parent-child structural relation for channel hierarchy.
Channel.LINKS: Canonical relation for non-owning channel linkage across trees.
Channel.LINKS_CHANNEL: Legacy channel link relation copied forward to LINKS.
Channel.OWNS: Optional ownership-path relation where a channel path explicitly owns another channel.

Category.CONTAINS_CATEGORY: Structural relation for categories nested under a channel.
Category.LINKS: Canonical relation for attaching categories to channels without changing hierarchy.
Category.LINKS_CATEGORY: Legacy category link relation copied forward to LINKS.

Category.CONTAINS_CATEGORY: Parent-child structural relation for nested categories.

SubjectRef.CONTAINS_SUBJECT: Owned hierarchy relation that attaches subjects under a category.
SubjectRef.LINKS: Canonical relation for linking subjects into another category without deleting owned hierarchy.
